body:
### Problem
Review run `7befde0957526de9` on task:de40fa1ed5320332 reads many symbols one at a time; the earlier review `a8eea7f746f351a8` does the same. There is no tool limit: `inspect a b c --context` takes several names, and both runs batch some related symbols. The review role says "Read what you need in small batches, one concern at a time," which invites one symbol per call. Reviews also do not get the session-start reference, so they miss its "Read once: `inspect checkout.pay payments.capture --context`" guidance.

The result is more turns: each call re-reads the conversation. Batching unrelated symbols would add noise and can trim `--context`, so the fix is one call per concern, not one call for everything.

### Change
- In `board.brief`'s review role, replace "Read what you need in small batches, one concern at a time" with: "For each concern, inspect every symbol it needs in one call (`inspect a b c --context`); split only when the reply is trimmed." Keep the concern-by-concern focus.
- Add a short read-once line to review briefs, without adding the full session start: "A call is a turn, so batch the symbols one concern needs; start from the changed symbols the review context names."
- Leave work, investigate and discuss briefs unchanged; they already carry the read-once reference.

### Tests
- A review brief contains the one-call-per-concern line and the read-once line, and no longer says "small batches."
- A review brief still holds the task diff and does not gain the full session-start reply.
- Run `rust-unit` and `rust-board-tests`.

### Not checked
No code was run or changed in this planning run.
title: reviews: batch a concern's reads
